entries.description: An MCP orchestrator that aggregates many MCP servers behind 8 meta-tools, eliminating context-window bloat. Instead of exposing 50 servers x 20 tools = 1000 tool definitions, agents always see only 8 tools and discover the rest on demand via fuzzy tool search, then execute any tool on any connected server. Supports runtime registration, OAuth, and SLOP scripts for multi-server code execution.
representativeQueries: find a tool that can read files across my connected MCP servers
register a new MCP server and list its tools
run a script that calls tools on several MCP servers at once
search every connected server for a tool to create a GitHub issue
authenticate an MCP server over OAuth
